newsitem.title: BELGIUM: European unemployment stable at 10.9 percent in October.
newsitem.headline: European unemployment stable at 10.9 percent in October.

text.p: Unemployment in the European Union stood at 10.9 percent in October, the same level as it has been for seven months, the EU's statistics office Eurostat said Tuesday.
The figure, which compares with 5.2 percent in the United States and 3.3 percent in Japan, means 18.2 million people are out of work in the 15-nation bloc.

The data included results of a survey on the Spanish labour force which caused recent figures to be revised upwards, the Luxembourg-based statistics office said. Spain has by far the worse jobless record in the Union with a 22.3-percent rate in October.
Luxembourg and Austria continue to have the lowest rates of 3.2 and 4.1 percent.
Following are comparative, seasonaly adjusted national unemployment rates in the EU. Eurostat did not provide figures for Greece and recent data were not available for Italy and the Netherlands.
